body:
[bitfix](https://github.com/trumank/bitfix) by trumank, commit
[`80af6c23`](https://github.com/trumank/bitfix/commit/80af6c231cb9bb1d441f02b3c66da3dbd4af115e) (2024-12-11, bitfix
0.1.0), republished with a ready package for Wuchang: Fallen Feathers.

Files:

- `wuchang_bitfix_v0.1.0-80af6c23.zip`: the Wuchang: Fallen Feathers Mod Enabler. It turns off the game's pak
  signature check, so the game loads mod paks from `Project_Plague\Content\Paks\~mods\`. Unpack it into the game's
  main folder (the one that holds `Project_Plague\`); the files land in `Project_Plague\Binaries\Win64\`, next to
  `Project_Plague-Win64-Shipping.exe`: the bitfix DLL as `d3d9.dll` and `dsound.dll`, the patch `bitfix\sig.lua`,
  and `bitfix-LICENSE.txt`. The same package the author uses with the game.
- `SHA256SUMS.txt`: the SHA-256 of the zip.

To remove it: delete `d3d9.dll`, `dsound.dll`, the folder `bitfix\` and `bitfix-LICENSE.txt` from
`Project_Plague\Binaries\Win64\`.

bitfix is made by trumank (Truman Kilen), MIT license. This package is unofficial; report problems with bitfix itself
to https://github.com/trumank/bitfix/issues. What this fork adds: `FORK.md`; how to install and use it:
`openmods.md`.
